nodes.name: The Atlas of Worlds (concept)
nodes.summary: The endgame structure of PoE1: a web of alternate worlds ('maps') reached through the Map Device. Wiki lore says it was either found or created by the Elder as a hunting ground; after the Elder's defeat other powers (Maven, Eldritch Horrors, the Originator) contest it. PoE2 has its own, separate Atlas whose Precursor Towers are mentioned in PoE1 wiki lore.

sources.locator: section 'The Atlas of Worlds' / 'The Elder and the Shaper'
lead: 'The Atlas of Worlds may have originally been created as a feeding ground for the Elder'

nodes.name: Atlas of Worlds
nodes.summary: The dreamlike plane of interlinked worlds at the centre of PoE1's endgame; its mists reflect the desires of whoever walks it (Veritania's journal). Time there is 'a mirage' (Baran). Reached via the Map Device.

sources.locator: Journal I: 'There is only my will, my thoughts, and my expectations, reflected as countless echoes'
Journal III: 'Time in the Atlas is a mirage'

nodes.name: Map Device
nodes.summary: Ancient device of golden instruments that opens portals to the worlds of the Atlas. Per Valdo's Book of Memories it was built by the Watchers of Decay to travel to and lock the Elder's dreamland; Templar expeditions under High Templar Venarius found a broken one in Wraeclast's ruins and Valdo Caeserius (with the Shade's help) assembled it in the Oriath academy. Zana later found another in ruined Oriath; in the legacy epilogue Kirac rebuilt one from parts in the Vault of Venarius; Isla later reimagined it with Kalguuran runes. Different peoples are said to have built their own versions. No source in the corpus ties it to the Precursors.

sources.locator: Memory of Intrigue: 'The intricate golden instruments ... a hundred times more intricate'
Machinist's Vault Aberration quote: 'Different peoples created their own map devices'
lead + Book of Memories Page 9: 'The Watchers, they built the device'
Walkthrough: 'components to rebuild the Map Device' in the Vault of Venarius

nodes.name: Theopolis
nodes.summary: Capital city of the Theocracy of Oriath; site of the Oriath academy where Valdo worked and of the Templar Laboratory.

sources.locator: Memory of Wonder: 'a map of Theopolis'

nodes.name: Eternal Laboratory
nodes.summary: Malachai's laboratory of the Eternal Empire, built on the archbishop Lazhwar's thaumaturgy research into maps; Zana's hideout alternative in the legacy Atlas quests.

sources.locator: Eternal Empire section: 'Lazhwar... discovered maps to create the Eternal Laboratory'
Assignment: 'Talk to Zana in your Hideout or the Eternal Laboratory'

nodes.name: The Decay
nodes.summary: Ancient cosmic mould-like entity ('the Oblivion') from outside time and space that turns all it touches to void; the Elder is its servant. Dormant after the Elder's defeat.

nodes.name: Watchers of Decay
nodes.summary: Ancient organisation of parents founded when a nameless god told an Azmeri mother whose child was stolen about the Elder. They forged Starforge to subdue it by separating form and spirit. Their Map Device (Book of Memories p9) later became the Atlas device. Associated with the Order of the Djinn on the wiki; membership of Egrin/Qianga/Betucia is unclear.

nodes.name: Starforge
nodes.summary: Sealing blade that bound the Elder's physical form (leaving its spirit, the Shade, free). History of Wraeclast says the Watchers of Decay forged it; scarab flavour text instead credits the Order of the Djinn (Egrin forged it, Qianga delivered it to the Watchers, Betucia bore it to imprison the Elder and sacrificed themselves). Winged Cartography Scarab: 'The Sealing Blade has been removed'.

sources.locator: The Watchers of Decay: 'forge a weapon capable of subduing it - Starforge'

nodes.name: The Elder
nodes.summary: Entity of malignant madness and servant of the Decay that preyed on children, feeding on their nightmares and later on Valdo's memories. Released by Venarius, it hunted the Atlas until the exile and Zana expelled it with the Cosmic Arcana; a memory of it remains as a pinnacle boss (Uber Elder).

nodes.name: The Shade
nodes.summary: Name Valdo gave the Elder's free-roaming spirit in his dreams; it taught him thaumaturgy and said the Map Device would link the dreamlands to Wraeclast, then asked him to pull the sword (Starforge) from its body.

nodes.name: High Templar Venarius
nodes.summary: Puritanical High Templar who destroyed heretical texts and commissioned Valdo to assemble the Map Device; kidnapped Zana to force Valdo into the dreamlands, bargained with the Elder for power and was killed by it. In Synthesis he appears as a memory boss.

sources.locator: Valdo Caeserius: 'Venarius tried to negotiate with the Elder ... it killed Venarius and his men'

nodes.name: Valdo Caeserius
nodes.summary: Chief Arkhon of the Oriath academy and father of Zana; dreamed of the Elder's dreamlands, was pulled into the Atlas, and fought the Elder until it ate his memories, becoming the Shaper. Aberration quotes show him grieving his Templar-killed wife.

nodes.name: The Shaper
nodes.summary: Valdo Caeserius reduced by the Elder's memory-feeding to a shell who 'shapes' worlds in the Atlas and no longer recognises Zana. Guarded by four Guardians of the Void; pinnacle boss in the Shaper's Realm.

sources.locator: Memory of Awakening: 'I will forge a world anew'
Zana: 'the Shaper was in reality Zana's father, Valdo'

nodes.name: Zana, Master Cartographer
nodes.summary: Valdo's daughter. Orphaned, she fled Oriath before exile, found a Map Device in ruined Oriath and mapped the Atlas. She hunted the Shaper and Elder, hired the Elderslayers, sealed the device when they went mad and left the Atlas after Sirus burned Oriath.

nodes.name: Zana, the Originator
nodes.summary: Secrets of the Atlas NPC (also Zana Caeserius) who threads memories across the Atlas, working to destroy the Atlas, fracturing it into four quadrants. Nature uncertain: she declares 'I am not your sister' to Eagon, and her relation to the Zana of the Elderslayers era is not spelled out.

sources.locator: Witness Zana and Eagon: 'The only way is to destroy it ... The Atlas'

nodes.name: Eagon Caeserius
nodes.summary: Scholar and Atlas researcher who claims Zana as his sister and Valdo as father; chases the Originator's memory threads with the exile via Memory Tears and Astrolabes. Hints that his parentage is uncertain ('If I am not Valdo's bastard...'); his identity is a community mystery.

sources.locator: Speak to Eagon quest log; Memory Vault dialogue
dev commentary: Eagon's situation remains complicated

nodes.name: Isla
nodes.summary: Former Templar chosen by Venarius to maintain the Map Device; now in Kingsmarch corresponding with Zana and experimenting with Kalguuran runes in map devices.

nodes.name: Eramir

sources.locator: Valdo: 'until Eramir sent in ancient parchments'

nodes.summary: Successor of Venarius as High Templar and exiler of the PoE1 protagonist.

nodes.name: The Shaper's Realm
nodes.summary: Realm at the centre of the Atlas where the Shaper is fought ('the Crucible' in the legacy quest); the Uber Elder fight takes place in its version of the Absence of Value and Meaning.

sources.locator: Assignment 11: 'found the Shaper in the Crucible'

nodes.name: Absence of Value and Meaning
nodes.summary: Elder's arena in the Atlas.

sources.locator: 'defeat The Elder in Absence of Value and Meaning'

nodes.name: Memory Fragments of the Shaper
nodes.summary: Seven in-game diary entries (Home, Intrigue, Wonder, Dream, Nightmare, Grief, Awakening) in which Valdo describes the golden device, dreams, Zana's capture and resolving to 'forge a world anew'. Partly superseded by the Book of Memories retcon.

nodes.name: Cosmic Arcana
nodes.summary: Weapon Valdo designed against the Elder; Zana found his key and used it to expel the Elder from the Atlas.

nodes.name: Commissioned by Kirac, the Exile Enters the Atlas
nodes.summary: After the campaign the Exile receives a tier-1 map from Commander Kirac, kills a map boss and is commissioned to aid the Citizen Vanguard.

nodes.name: Zana's Hidden Architect: the Shaper Hunt
nodes.summary: Legacy story: Zana sends the Exile into Shaper-influenced maps; seven memory fragments reveal the Shaper's origin as Valdo.

nodes.name: The Exile Defeats the Shaper
nodes.summary: After breaking the four Guardians, the Exile and Zana beat the Shaper in his Realm; he drops The Shaper's Key.

nodes.name: The Exile and Zana Expel the Elder
nodes.summary: The Exile lures the Elder to the centre of the Atlas and Zana uses the Cosmic Arcana; the Elder is defeated.

nodes.name: Zana's Elderslayers Hunt the Elder
nodes.summary: Parallel (previous exile) history: Zana recruits Baran, Veritania, Drox, Al-Hezmin and Sirus; Sirus sacrifices himself into the Arcana trap.

nodes.name: The Conquerors Fall Into Madness
nodes.summary: Zana seals the Map Device; the Elderslayers split and each pursues their vice in the Atlas. Legacy epilogue quests Picking Up the Pieces / Chasing a Dream / The Crusader began with Kirac asking the Exile to find Baran.

sources.locator: start: 'Kirac's brother Baran has been driven insane and is lurking in the Atlas'

nodes.name: Sirus Awakens and Burns Oriath
nodes.summary: Sirus returns with a storm, builds his own device, burns Oriath; the Exile defeats him; Zana leaves the Atlas.

nodes.name: The Envoy Introduces the Maven
nodes.summary: Map bosses killed under the Maven's witness earn her Beacon and Invitations.

nodes.name: Siege of the Atlas: Exarch and Eater
nodes.summary: Eldritch Horrors (Searing Exarch, Eater of Worlds, Black Star, Infinite Hunger) approach; the Exile defeats their champions.

nodes.name: Threads of the Originator
nodes.summary: Eagon and the Exile chase Zana's memory threads, defeat the Incarnations of Neglect, Fear and Dread; the Atlas is shattered.

nodes.name: The Elderslayers
nodes.summary: Group Zana assembled to hunt the Elder: Baran, Veritania, Drox, Al-Hezmin, led by Sirus. They became the Conquerors of the Atlas after going mad.

nodes.name: Sirus, Awakener of Worlds
nodes.summary: Smuggler and leader of the Elderslayers who loved Zana; sacrificed himself into the Arcana trap and returned empty and mad. He burned Oriath and is a pinnacle boss; journals narrate his fall.

nodes.name: Baran, the Crusader
nodes.summary: Templar elderslayer who hears 'God's whispers', blames Zana for sealing the device and plans an Atlas nation; brother of Kirac. Kirac says the Maven resurrects him to watch his fights with the Exile.

nodes.name: Veritania, the Redeemer
nodes.summary: Scholar elderslayer who retreats into puritan disgust at the Atlas' vices and becomes the Redeemer.

nodes.name: Drox, the Warlord
nodes.summary: Warrior elderslayer who strives to found a just kingdom in the Atlas through force.

nodes.name: Al-Hezmin, the Hunter
nodes.summary: Competitive hunter elderslayer of Redblade clan origin who keeps a journal of rivalries and plots to kill Drox.

nodes.name: Sirus Burns Oriath
nodes.summary: Sirus used his own map device to enter Oriath and burn it down; Kirac took a blow meant for Zana; the Exile defeated him. In Siege timeline an unknown exile dealt Sirus a near-fatal blow at the cost of her life.

nodes.name: Journals of the Conquerors
nodes.summary: Lore objects in the Conquerors' arenas (added 3.9.2) narrating each Elderslayer's descent.

nodes.name: Watchstones
nodes.summary: Crystallised memories of the Elder's past victims, expelled when it was defeated by the Cosmic Arcana; Baran left one behind (Zana dialogue). As game items, Watchstones were socketed into Citadels in the legacy 3.9-3.16 Atlas. Their relation to Voidstones is not stated in the corpus.

nodes.name: Voidstones
nodes.summary: Atlas upgrades unlocked by defeating pinnacle bosses and talking to Kirac: Decayed (Elder), Ceremonial (Maven), Omniscient/Grasping (Searing Exarch / Eater quests, 3.17), Originator Voidstone (Incarnation of Dread). In 3.28.0 the Exarch and Eater together give one Voidstone and the Incarnation of Dread gives the extra one.

nodes.name: Commander Kirac
nodes.summary: Tracker and officer of Oriath's volunteer Citizen Vanguard, later Commander; younger brother of Baran. In legacy epilogue quests he asked the Exile to find Baran, who had fallen in with 'radical' Zana Caeserius. Sits in the Karui Shores War Room, issues maps, pinnacle invitations and Atlas Books of Skill, calls the Exile 'Godslayer' and backs the Maven as 'the best of our terrible options'. Took Sirus's blow meant for Zana. His dialogue says the Maven resurrects Baran for her games.

sources.locator: quote: 'My younger brother, Baran, fell in with a radical by the name of Zana Caeserius'
KiracOnBaranResurrectionTwo; Introduction: 'tracker and officer in Oriath's new Citizen Vanguard'
Kirac: 'She's the best of our terrible options'

nodes.name: Citizen Vanguard
nodes.summary: Force Kirac leads to defend Wraeclast against coming darkness; over 800 died against Sirus in Siege timeline.

nodes.name: The Envoy
nodes.summary: Messenger NPC met in T6+ maps who introduces the Maven and the Eldritch Horrors, speaking of the Struggle over the Atlas; speaks of Cleansing Fire's blindness to 'the lightkeeper'. Also gives the Flesh Compass and Luminous Astrolabe that let the Exile hunt the Tangle's and Cleansing Fire's footholds.

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Envoy gives Flesh Compass / Luminous Astrolabe

nodes.name: The Maven
nodes.summary: Primordial claimant of the Atlas who is 'bored with the realm she has given', serving only her own amusement; not the Elder but to be feared. She witnesses map bosses and traps challengers in her Memory Game. Her origin is unresolved.

sources.locator: Envoy: 'She is not The Elder, but you are right to fear her.'

nodes.name: The Struggle
nodes.summary: Ancient conflict among cosmic forces (the Decay, the Tangle, the Cleansing Fire) introduced by the Envoy. The forces cannot clash directly without rending reality, so disputes are settled by duels between mortal champions. The Elder's defeat left a vacancy over the Atlas that drew the others in; the Maven, with the Exile as her champion and Kirac's Vanguard, stands against the Eldritch champions. A progenitor/Lightkeeper is cited as the order the forces are blind to.

sources.locator: lead: 'defeat of the Elder ... created a temporary vacancy'

nodes.name: The Maven's Beacon
nodes.summary: Map Device upgrade from the first Maven-witnessed boss kill enabling witnessing.

nodes.name: Echoes of the Atlas (3.13.0)
nodes.summary: League/expansion that introduced the Maven and the Envoy.

nodes.name: The Cleansing Fire
nodes.summary: Cosmic force: sentient neural network of suns and black stars seeking omniscience by disintegrating what it studies; served by the Black Star and the Searing Exarch. Its all-seeing-eye symbol resembles the descry and may be origin of Templar religion (wiki inference).

sources.locator: Lycia: 'prayed to symbol of the Cleansing Fire ... Innocence appropriated it'
Cleansing Fire section: 'omnipotent neural network of suns and black stars'; symbol 'very similar to the descry'

nodes.name: The Tangle
nodes.summary: Cosmic force served by the Infinite Hunger and the Eater of Worlds (flavour: sea of limbs, to eat, to feast).

nodes.name: The Searing Exarch
nodes.summary: Eldritch Horror serving the Cleansing Fire; seeks to master the Atlas; fought in the Absence of Patience and Wisdom.

nodes.name: The Black Star
nodes.summary: Champion of the Cleansing Fire met in the Polaric Void; precedes the Exarch.

nodes.name: The Eater of Worlds
nodes.summary: Eldritch Horror serving the Tangle, fought in Absence of Symmetry and Harmony.

nodes.name: The Infinite Hunger
nodes.summary: Primary champion of the Tangle fought in the Seething Chyme.

nodes.name: Siege of the Atlas (3.17.0)
nodes.summary: Expansion that added the Searing Exarch, Eater of Worlds and the Eldritch system.

nodes.name: Uber pinnacle bosses
nodes.summary: Harder repeatable versions: Uber Elder, Uber Sirus, Uber Maven, Uber Exarch/Eater after 24 influenced T14+ maps. Memory-version retellings per Day Zero.

nodes.name: Uber Elder
nodes.summary: Harder memory-version of the Elder met in the Shaper's Realm; Elder is a memory defeated 'with aid of a certain rogue cartographer' (Zana).

nodes.name: Cavas, Forgotten Spirit
nodes.summary: Memoryless spirit/old man in Synthesis who seeks his lost memories in the Memory Nexus; fragments suggest a beach childhood. Exact identity not resolved in sources read.

nodes.name: Memory Nexus
nodes.summary: Synthesis hub in the Atlas where stabilised memories are connected into paths to memory bosses like the Cortex.

nodes.name: Synthesis league
nodes.summary: 3.6.0 challenge league (Mar 2019) centred on Cavas and decaying memories; bosses later became unique map content and Kirac missions.

nodes.name: The Cortex
nodes.summary: Synthesis memory boss in a Distant Memory in the Nexus (arena forms listed as Fractal Gargantuan, Synthete Masterpiece, Fractal Titan, Synthete Nightmare).

nodes.name: Secrets of the Atlas (3.26.0)
nodes.summary: Expansion launched 13 June 2025 (3.26.0, with Mercenaries league) adding Eagon, Zana the Originator, Memory Tears and the Incarnations; 3.28.0 reworked the Atlas.

sources.locator: release 2025-06-13, 'Path of Exile: Secrets of the Atlas' 3.26.0

nodes.name: Memory Tears and Threads
nodes.summary: Tears in Atlas reality where Zana's manifested memories leak; Eagon traces threads to Moments of Loneliness, Trauma, Reverence.

nodes.name: Zana the Originator Fractures the Atlas
nodes.summary: After the Incarnation of Dread, Zana tells Eagon she must destroy the Atlas, 'I am the catalyst', fracturing it into four quadrants and burning its pages; 3.28.0 rendering visible as the destroyed Atlas.

sources.locator: Witness Zana and Eagon; Rewards 3.28 image

nodes.name: Incarnation of Neglect
nodes.summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Loneliness: Zana asks Valdo to admire the Atlas; 'Not now, Zana!'. Interpretive: its Valdo/Zana 'Not now, Zana!' memory suggests it embodies Valdo's neglect; the wiki does not state this.

nodes.name: The Neglected Flame
nodes.summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Neglect; Eagon siphons its kernel.

nodes.name: Incarnation of Fear
nodes.summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Trauma: Valdo's fury at Zana.

nodes.name: The Cardinal of Fear
nodes.summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Fear; Eagon siphons its kernel.

nodes.name: Incarnation of Dread
nodes.summary: Warped memory-boss of the Originator's threads. Moment of Reverence: Valdo's promise of a brighter future.

nodes.name: The Deceitful God
nodes.summary: Memory boss guarding the thread that leads to the Incarnation of Dread; Eagon siphons its kernel.

nodes.name: Atlas Rework and Destroyed Atlas (3.28.0)
nodes.summary: March 2026 (Mirage league patch) reworked the Atlas: content physically on Atlas, one Voidstone from Exarch+Eater, third from Incarnation of Dread, Eagon now tries to stop Zana severing threads using Astrolabes.

nodes.name: Keepers / Mirage / Allflame leagues (2025-26)
nodes.summary: 2025-26 challenge leagues (Keepers 3.27.0, Mirage 3.28.0, Allflame 3.29.0) do not continue the Atlas story directly; Keepers continues Breach lore.

nodes.name: Qianga
nodes.summary: Named on a Gilded Shaper Scarab as the 'Deliverer of the Sealing Blade to the Watchers'; probably an Order of the Djinn member (wiki says unclear).

nodes.name: Betucia
nodes.summary: Named on a Gilded Cartography Scarab as 'Bearer of the Sealing Blade' who sacrificed themselves to imprison the Elder; the Order of the Djinn 'will be forever wounded by your loss'.

nodes.name: The Lightkeeper (the Progenitor)
nodes.summary: Progenitor figure named by the Envoy: the Cleansing Fire is blind to 'the path set before it by the lightkeeper'; Struggle page says he tests the limits of limitless power and directs the weavers of destiny. Nature and relation to the Maven unresolved.

nodes.name: Kirac Seeks His Brother Baran (legacy)
nodes.summary: Legacy (3.9-3.16) epilogue quests: Kirac enlists the Exile to find his brother Baran, who joined Zana Caeserius's expedition; the Map Device is rebuilt from components in the Vault of Venarius and Zana appears in the Atlas, leading to the Elderslayers/Conquerors storyline. Removed in 3.17.
